title: Wok-hei Oven-Roasted German Polish Sausage Hash
description: An adventurous German-inspired dish featuring wok-hei, Polish sausage, and a rich winey, glassy-jelly sauce. Can be enjoyed as a lacto-vegetarian-friendly breakfast or brunch option.

ingredients.name: Wok hei oil (or vegetable oil)
ingredients.notes: Can be made by cooking oil in a hot wok.

ingredients.name: Wine (e.g. Merlot)
ingredients.notes: Red wine. Can be reduced to 1/2 cup for less intense flavor.

instructions: Arrange bamboo shoots and cabbage on a bamboo tray or a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Cut Polish sausage into 1-inch pieces and cook in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add sliced red onion and red bell pepper to the wok and cook until the vegetables start to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add sliced garlic and ginger to the wok and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add wine to the wok and cook until reduced by half, about 2-3 minutes.
Stir in Dijon mustard and cook for 1 minute.
Add flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add cooked sausage and vegetables to the wok and stir to combine.
Transfer the wok contents to the prepared bamboo tray or baking sheet.
Roast in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the flavors are well combined.
Garnish with chopped green onions before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
